title: Edit a water-saving reflection in the right order
instructions: Verified notes: Arif learned in mathematics to compare like quantities; at home he recorded shower duration on five ordinary days, tried a timer on five later days, and observed shorter durations on four of those days; the small trial did not measure water flow or prove a result for everyone. Edit by task, structure, development, then conventions.

parts.prompt: Which problem should be repaired first?

options.text: The draft never explains how the mathematics idea guided Arif's home trial.
One comma is missing.
The word ‘duration’ repeats.
A sentence could be shorter.

choice_rationales.D: Style is not the first pass.

parts.hint: Start with whether the response answers the prompt.

parts.prompt: Which focus sentence best centres the response?

options.text: Water matters to everyone.
Mathematics has many topics.
Learning to compare like quantities helped me design a small, fairer test of my shower routine.
Timers are the greatest invention.

choice_rationales.C: This names learning, action and bounded purpose.

parts.correct_explanation: The third sentence controls the response.

options.text: Result → classroom lesson → method → reflection
Classroom principle → ordinary-day record → timer trial → result and limitation → reflection
Limitation → unrelated anecdote → result
Reflection → result → new claim

choice_rationales.A: The result arrives before its basis.
choice_rationales.B: This establishes cause and evidence before meaning.

options.text: I recorded the duration on five ordinary days.
I then used a timer on five later days.
Four later showers were shorter than my ordinary-day records.
Our bathroom tiles have a blue wave pattern.

choice_rationales.D: This does not advance task, method or reflection.

parts.hint: Ask what job the detail performs.

parts.prompt: Which correction belongs in the final conventions pass?

options.text: Change ‘five later day’ to ‘five later days’.
Add an invented water-volume estimate.
Replace the focus with a new topic.
Move the result before the method.

choice_rationales.A: This is number agreement after content is secure.

parts.correct_explanation: Plural agreement belongs in the final pass.

parts.prompt: Which revision best completes all four passes?

options.text: Maths is useful. I used a timer. It worked for everyone.
Our blue bathroom is nice, and timers save exactly fifty litres.

In mathematics I learned to compare like quantities. I recorded five ordinary shower durations, then tested a timer across five later days. Four were shorter, which suggested the timer could help my routine, although I had not measured water flow or proved the result for others. The trial taught me to make a limited claim from limited evidence.
I learned mathematics because showers are important.

choice_rationales.C: This is focused, ordered, developed and controlled.

parts.hint: Check task, order, evidence and conventions.
parts.correct_explanation: The third revision preserves all verified notes and their limits.
